note: Charlie's Descript export 'Duo' (Nov 23): narration with his music bed, mono 44.1 kHz, 39.42 s; voice and music start together at 0.2 s and the music fades out by 38.8 s. The track is delayed 4.4 s so the morning text-fight hook and the rewind play with only their chimes, then his voice and music come in at night. Word times from a forced alignment of the script. End card follows 'One map.' and holds through the fade.
lines: Sam and Jo are building an app to split bills for their apartment.
Each one works at night, with their own Claude Code.
The problem: neither agent knows what the other one did.
So every morning, something one of them built has been redone.
Then they pointed both agents at Dandy.
Now each agent checks the same live map before it starts.
It sees what's built, and what the other one is working on right now.
When Jo's agent reached for Groceries, Dandy stopped it.
And nothing's marked done until a different agent reviews it.
Same app. Two builders. One map.
